plan: A gravedigger who summons ghouls and a Maiden of the Mist to bring down towers.
aSurveiller: His W (Dark Procession). A wall that traps you: destroy it by attacking it or keep a dash to get out.
contrer: Attack his wall (W) to break it: it traps you.
Kill his ghouls: together they deal a lot of damage.
Don't let him push alone: he destroys towers fast.

sorts.Q: Empowered attack that leaves a grave.
sorts.R: Summons the Maiden of the Mist.
